label: Wearables
question: Can cloth carry a story on the body?
title: Wearables
intro: I design and sew clothing in colour and pattern reminiscent of my origins — garments made from my own textiles.
quote: Fashion is self-expression. It is who I am, how I feel, and who I want to be.
story: Long before Nuaj, I was designing and sewing clothing for myself and for friends — learning through trial and error, experimenting with colour and pattern.
Nuaj wearables bring that practice together with the studio's textiles: lace, aso-oke and beadwork, cut and composed into pieces you can live in.
imageAlt: Collage from Stephanie's sketchbook: a dress she designed and sewed from African-print fabrics
